app.pageDesc: Manage your LINE / Telegram AI customer service

dashboard.title: Home
dashboard.comingSoon: Use "Store settings" in the menu to edit store info, FAQ and languages. "Bookings", "Conversations" and "AI cost" show how the bot is doing.

merchant.title: Store info
merchant.name: Name
merchant.knowledgeHelp: Opening hours, address, payment and so on. The AI answers only from these and the FAQ.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.help: Write in your preferred language. The AI answers only from the FAQ and knowledge sections.
faq.question: Question
faq.altQuestions: Other ways to ask (one per line, optional)

warnings.faq_filtered: You have {count} FAQs. For each message, the {top} most similar ones are picked first for the AI to choose from; questions phrased the way customers ask are easier to pick.
warnings.faq_too_long: Up to about {chars} characters of FAQ are sent to the AI at once. Over {limit}, the on-device model may fail to answer (the chat is handed to staff). Please shorten the longer answers: {targets}.
warnings.knowledge_section_long: These knowledge sections are longer than {limit} characters: {targets}. When picked, the on-device model may fail to answer (the chat is handed to staff); consider splitting them into shorter sections.
warnings.knowledge_too_long: The 3 longest knowledge sections total {chars} characters ({targets}), over {limit}. When picked together, the on-device model may fail to answer (the chat is handed to staff); consider shortening or splitting them.

language.title: Languages
language.customerHelp: The bot replies to customers in these languages.
language.preferredHelp: The language you write all store content in. It must be one of the checked customer languages.
language.unmeasuredWarning: Reply quality has not been measured for: {langs}

replies.title: Fixed replies
replies.help: What the bot says as-is in these situations. Edit the preferred-language version and save, and AI translates it into the other languages; fix any translation directly and save again.
replies.preferredHelp: One sentence per line; the bot picks one at random. Keep variables in braces such as {'{'}name{'}'}.
replies.emptyTranslation: Left empty, it is translated automatically when you save
replies.translating: Translating, this may take a few dozen seconds…

booking.title: Booking
booking.help: When on, the bot collects booking details from customers and asks your staff to confirm.
booking.offReply: What customers are told when it's off is edited in Fixed replies:
booking.fieldsHelp: Date, time, name and phone are always asked. You can turn off party size and add fields your business needs (e.g. service, preferred stylist).
booking.peopleHelp: When off, party size isn't asked or saved, and staff group booking notices don't show it.
booking.customHelp: Required fields are asked in order after the time and before the name. Optional fields aren't asked; they're saved only when the customer mentions them. The bot asks "Could you tell me your (name)?".
booking.fieldKeyHelp: Used by the system; avoid changing it once saved (e.g. service, designer).
booking.keyFormat: Key must start with a lowercase letter and use only lowercase letters, digits and underscores
booking.fieldDescriptionHelp: Tells the AI what to record, e.g. "The service the customer wants, such as a haircut or coloring".
booking.fieldRequiredHelp: Unchecked means optional: not asked, saved only when the customer mentions it.

handoff.title: Staff handoff
handoff.help: After a handoff, the AI stops replying to that customer and your staff reply from the Telegram staff group.
handoff.unbound: No staff group linked yet, so handoff notifications can't be sent
handoff.bindHelp: Add the bot to your staff's Telegram group and send /bind {code} in the group to link it. To switch groups, regenerate the code and send it in the new group.
handoff.confirmRegenerate: The old code will stop working. Continue?
handoff.offReply: When off, the bot doesn't hand off; what customers are told (including your contact info) is edited in Fixed replies:
handoff.onNoAnswer: Hand off when there's no answer
handoff.onNoAnswerHelp: When off, the bot says it isn't sure what the customer means.
handoff.streakLimitHelp: Hand off after the customer says this many unverifiable or off-topic things in a row (1–10).
handoff.autoEndHelp: Minutes after the staff's last reply before the AI resumes. 0 means never.
handoff.serviceHoursHelp: Outside these hours the bot still hands off and tells the customer staff will reply later. A start later than the end runs past midnight into the next day (e.g. 18:00–02:00). Slots can't overlap.
handoff.prompt: What customers are told on handoff

model.title: Model
model.noKey: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set on the server, so you can't switch to Haiku. To use Haiku, set the API key on the server and restart it.
model.budgetHelp: When this month's Haiku cost reaches the limit, the bot switches to the on-device model. 0 means no limit.

intentExamples.title: Intent examples
intentExamples.description: Example sentences and what the customer wants. The bot looks at the most similar ones to understand a message. Built-in examples are read-only; you can add and delete your own.

customIntents.title: Custom intents
customIntents.help: Besides the built-in intents, you can add up to 10 intents, each with one action. Built-in intents can't be changed.
customIntents.name: Name
customIntents.descriptionHelp: What customers say for this intent. The AI decides based on this description.
customIntents.examplesHelp: One per line, at least {n}. They can't repeat examples of other intents.
customIntents.textHelp: Write it in your preferred language; it's translated automatically for other languages.
customIntents.prompt: Message to the customer when handing off (optional)
customIntents.promptHelp: Leave empty to use the default handoff message. If handoff is turned off, the handoff settings apply.
customIntents.sectionsPlaceholder: Choose the sections to answer from

selfTest.title: Classification self-test
selfTest.help: After saving, every example sentence (built-in, your own, and custom intent examples) is classified once. Sentences classified as another intent are listed here; they may be too close to another intent, so consider changing the description or examples.
selfTest.running: Testing, this may take a few minutes…
selfTest.failed: The test failed. Please run it again later.
selfTest.summary: Tested {total} sentences: {conflicts} classified as another intent, {failed} AI failures
selfTest.failedItems: AI failures (not conflicts, you can run again):

pendingQuestions.title: Unanswered questions
pendingQuestions.description: Messages the bot couldn't answer. The same question is merged and counted. You can turn one into an FAQ, add it to a knowledge section, add it as an intent example, or ignore it.
pendingQuestions.noConversation: The conversation log is past its retention period
pendingQuestions.sectionHelp: Pick an existing section to append to it, or type a new title to add a section.
pendingQuestions.ignoreHelp: Ignored questions leave the to-do list. The same question is still counted later.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.description: Booking requests customers sent through the bot, newest first.
bookings.handleInGroup: View only. Confirm or reject bookings in the Telegram staff group.
bookings.name: Name

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.description: Conversations between the bot and each customer, with every AI decision.
conversations.search: Search customer ID or message text
conversations.retention: Conversations are kept for 90 days and then deleted automatically.
conversations.handingOff: This customer is handed off to staff; the bot will not reply
conversations.confirmEndHandoff: After ending the handoff, the bot will reply to this customer again (the customer is not notified). End it?
conversations.silent: (Handed off to staff, the bot did not reply)
conversations.sendFailedHint: This reply was not delivered to the customer

steps.ask: Check if asking about the store

reasons.quote_not_in_source: Blocked: quote not found in the data
reasons.number_not_in_quote: Blocked: number not in the data ({arg})

usage.title: AI cost
usage.description: AI calls and cost this month (Taipei time).
usage.afmFree: The Apple on-device model is free; only calls are counted. Failed means the AI gave no usable answer.
